name: MIRACL Thai
purpose: Thai passage-retrieval benchmark for Recall@K, Precision@K, Hit Rate@K, MRR, and nDCG.
corpus_format: gzip-compressed JSONL with docid, title, text
local_preparation: evalops dataset prepare miracl --language th --split dev
full_benchmark: evalops benchmark miracl --language th --split dev --retriever bm25 --k 10 --data-dir datasets/external/miracl/th/dev
checksum: SHA-256 recorded for every locally prepared artifact; upstream corpus checksums are not guessed
